lessons.title: -ann agus -eann
lessons.rule: In the present tense, add -ann to a broad root (last vowel a, o or u) and -eann to a slender root (last vowel i or e), then put the subject: glan becomes glanann sí, cuir becomes cuireann sí. With muid use the same form: glanann muid.
steps: Find the root of the verb in brackets: glan.
The last vowel is a, so the root is broad: add -ann to get glanann.
Put the verb first, then the subject: Glanann sí a seomra leapa.

lessons.title: -aim agus -im: ceist a fhreagairt
lessons.rule: To answer a question with tú, use the mé ending, -aim for a broad root and -im for a slender root, with no pronoun after it: An nglanann tú? Glanaim. Change do to mo, ort to orm and leat to liom.
steps: Take An and the eclipsis off the verb: gcuireann becomes cuireann.
Drop tú and write the answer: Cuirim an pláta ar an tábla.

lessons.title: Ceist le An, diúltach le Ní
lessons.en: Questions with An, negatives with Ní
lessons.rule: For a question put An before the verb and eclipse it (An gcaitheann, An bhfágann); for a negative put Ní before it and lenite it (Ní chaitheann, Ní fhágann). l, m, n, r and s do not change after An, and l, n, r, sc, sm, sp and st do not change after Ní.
steps: Start from the answer and take off Ní and the h: Ní chuireann siad becomes cuireann siad.
Put An in front and eclipse the c: An gcuireann siad.
Finish the question: An gcuireann siad an pláta ar an tábla?

lessons.title: An saorbhriathar: -tar
lessons.rule: When nobody is named as doing the action, add -tar to a broad root and put no pronoun after it: glan becomes glantar. After An it is eclipsed and after Ní lenited: An nglantar? Ní ghlantar.
steps: Find the root of the verb in brackets: múch.
The last vowel is u, so the root is broad: add -tar to get múchtar.
Put it first, with no pronoun: Múchtar na soilse ar a deich a chlog.

lessons.title: An saorbhriathar: -tear
lessons.rule: If the last vowel of the root is i or e (a slender root), add -tear instead, still with no pronoun: cuir becomes cuirtear, druid becomes druidtear.
steps: Find the root of the verb in brackets: blais.
The last vowel is i, so the root is slender: add -tear to get blaistear.
Put it first, with no pronoun: Blaistear an bia sa cheaintín.

lessons.title: Briathra a thosaíonn ar ghuta
lessons.rule: A verb beginning with a vowel takes the same endings (ólann, ólaim, óltar) but never changes after An or Ní, because a vowel cannot be eclipsed or lenited: An ólann tú? Ní ólaim.
steps: Find the root of the verb in brackets: éist.
The last vowel is i, so add -eann: éisteann.
Ní does not change a vowel, so write it as it is: Ní éisteann sé leis an nuacht.

example.answer: Ní éisteann sé leis an nuacht.
